claims.trade: The article says Lokoja is a trade centre for agricultural products because it sits at the confluence of the Niger and Benue rivers.
claims.markets: The article says Lokoja has three major markets, New Market (International Market), Old Market and Kpata Market, and that the essential products sold in them are grains, vegetables and general household items.
claims.fishing: The article says Lokoja fishermen celebrate the Donkwo fishing festival in March or April and that editions of a Lokoja boat regatta are held, though not regularly.
